mirrors.summary: Contrastive codebook attention fusion for speech translation, combining codebook alignment with fused cross-attention layers.
Official release of cascade codebook adaptation for streaming ASR; codebook adaptation and streaming decoding for speech recognition.
Speech translation implementation of contrastive codebook alignment with a shared discrete vocabulary and pivot-free translation training.
Toolkit for aligning acoustic and textual codebooks in low-resource speech translation; contrastive objectives and vocabulary sharing utilities.
Chunked rotary attention for streaming summarization; rotary embeddings with chunked attention windows.
Long-context retrieval implementation of chunked rotary embeddings with phase-continuous chunking and a retrieval attention window.
Video transformer implementation combining deformable token merging with attention distillation; efficient token pruning and video attention kernels.
Community reproduction kit for deformable token merging in video transformers; scripts for token pruning and saliency supervision.
Video transformer toolkit implementing deformable token merging, a temporal saliency map and a learned token budget controller for efficient inference.
Calibration toolkit for early-exit detectors: exit gate calibration and confidence estimation on edge accelerators.
On-device detection implementation of entropy-calibrated early exit with confidence temperature scaling and calibrated exit gates.
Official implementation of energy-calibrated efficient detectors for on-device object detection and calibration.
General zoo of edge inference runtimes: early exit, quantization, calibrated detection heads and on-device deployment recipes.
General collection of efficient visual backbones: video transformers, token pruning, deformable attention variants and inference recipes.
Mixture-of-experts inference runtime implementing gradient-aware layer skipping with expert routing entropy and skip gates.
Annotated reading notes and bibliography for gradient-aware layer skipping in sparse mixture-of-experts inference.
General mixture-of-experts serving suite: routing, expert parallelism, layer dispatch and inference optimization recipes.
Utilities for chunked rotary position embeddings, context extension and long-document retrieval evaluation.
Real-time semantic segmentation implementation of stochastic depth pruning with a drop-path schedule and segmentation head sparsification.
General pruning suite for dense prediction: stochastic depth pruning, segmentation head sparsification and real-time model recipes.
Benchmark suite for layer skipping in sparse mixture-of-experts models; routing entropy logging and latency measurement.
Drop-path and stochastic depth utilities for real-time segmentation backbones; pruning schedules and head sparsification helpers.
